description: Locus tags and feature annotation of the KT2440 OprI ortholog and its genomic neighbours, with residue-level comparison to P. aeruginosa OprI

import requests, re, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
def info(acc):
    e=requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{acc}.json",timeout=30).json()
    ol=[g.get("orderedLocusNames",[]) for g in e.get("genes",[])]
    loci=[x["value"] for s in ol for x in s]
    names=[g.get("geneName",{}).get("value") for g in e.get("genes",[])]
    ft=[(f["type"],f["location"]["start"]["value"],f["location"]["end"]["value"]) for f in e.get("features",[]) if f["type"] in ("Signal","Lipid","Chain","Domain")]
    return loci,names,e["sequence"]["value"],ft
for acc in ["Q88KG8","Q88KH0","Q88MW7","Q88HW7"]:
    loci,names,seq,ft=info(acc)
    print(f"{acc}  locus={loci}  gene={names}  len={len(seq)}")
    for f in ft: print("        ",f)
